purpose: Non-windowed verification of Rust workspace deletion notice state/copy and shared folder/workspace text rendering; GUI and performance acceptance deferred

unit_verified_mechanisms: Complete irreversible-deletion and profile/password/history/cookie-retention warning, two-paragraph separator, Unicode title and default Cancel policy remain intact.
Admission rechecks configuration readiness/busy state, captured ID existence and remaining workspace count. Missing/empty/last targets and unavailable configuration return no deletion target.
Captured identity survives workspace reorder, name changes and profile assignment. Active selection is not an input and cannot redirect deletion.
Pending/accepted/cancelled notices cannot dispatch again. Immediate rejection is retryable and feedback clears on a newly admitted request; externally removed/replaced targets never redirect.

Shared paragraph geometry retains supplied blank-line slots and complete body/error extents, with a separating gap only when both parts exist. Existing folder notice/form and generic text tests still pass.
implemented_pending_runtime_verification: Workspace confirmation uses a distinct Rust controller and typed Delete request with a captured workspace ID; native callback retains beforeunload, tab/pin disposal, profile-data retention and persistence.

Folder and workspace controllers share NoticeCopy, notice_layout and NoticeBodyView rendering. CoreText shaping, Rust placement, clipped shared-context Metal canvases, static AX nodes/alerts, native fallback, typography caches and scene fingerprint skips remain.

Repeatable native modal OK callbacks close only on accepted admission; stale/unsafe/rejected actions retain the dialog with Rust inline feedback. Existing settings configuration-error delivery is preserved for service rejection.
Native modal title/buttons/default-key/focus/placement/lifetime remain adapters. Weak controller and renderer tasks prevent callbacks from retaining destroyed dialog contents.

The compiled GUI regression covers Unicode title/default Cancel, warning/AX text without Labels, active selection changes, beforeunload cancellation/acceptance, retained profile storage and stale-target inline GPU feedback. It has not run.
